lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is relatively uniform across the lateral torso, with a slight increase in frequency towards the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Anterior lines 1-3 and posterior lines 11-12 are abbreviated, terminating at approximately 50% of the vertical torso height. Lines 4-10 extend approximately 80% of the distance from the dorsal ridge toward the ventral surface.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: 4 high-contrast white spots located on the lower haunch, arranged in a loose cluster.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two most ventral spots on the haunch exhibit a horizontal geometric alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: Two white spots visible on the lower cheek/jaw area and a distinct white chevron-like band across the bridge of the snout. Dark pigmented pelage on the lower limbs extending from the hoof to the mid-carpal/tarsal region.
